intro: Relax and enjoy the timeless classic. Challenge yourself with the world's most beloved solitaire card game!
description:
Klondike Classic is the perfect solitaire experience for players who enjoy classic card games and relaxing puzzles.

Choose your favorite card back and enjoy a clean, elegant design focused on the classic Klondike experience.

Play at your own pace, sharpen your mind, and enjoy the timeless appeal of classic Solitaire!
